info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Liquidity Risk Model Management API
info.description: The Liquidity Risk Model Management API provides a robust platform for creating and managing liquidity risk models within banking applications. This API allows financial institutions to initiate the development of these models, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and enhancing risk assessment capabilities. Typical consumers include risk management teams and financial analysts who need to implement effective models for liquidity risk analysis. By streamlining the model creation process, this API facilitates better decision-making in banking operations.

post.summary: Create a new liquidity risk model.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new liquidity risk model by providing the necessary parameters in the request body. The model will be validated upon creation, and a response will indicate success or failure with relevant details.
